# Blueberries

Type: Food | Internal ID: Blueberries | Source: Blueberry bushes in the, Black Forest, biome | Usage: Building, Crafting, Eating, Taming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Max Health: 8 | Max Stamina: 25 | Duration: 10m | Healing: 1 hp/tick

# Introduction

Blueberries are berries found in the Black Forest.

## Availability

• Bushes in the Black Forest can be harvested for 1 Blueberries, affected by Farming (Skill). Bushes replenish after 5h. There is currently no way to replant berry bushes, and if they are destroyed they will not grow back.
• Randomly in barrels outside Greydwarf Towers.
